lead.headline: The Unbeaten Machine Gets Its Toughest Test
lead.deck: Bijan Your Face (4-0) is projected 172.1 to 146.6 over Stroke The Post after CeeDee Lamb scored 2.9 on Thursday. Jeff Longwood's upset of the week is winless Very Naughty Boys over Jackie aCHANe, and Lamar Jackson's absence hits four rosters.

stories.role: Sunday Picks · Never Met a Parlay He Didn't Like
stories.headline: Lamar's Out, Philly's Gutted, and I Found the Upset
intro: I've been up since the Thursday game. Tampa went into Dallas as roughly a nine-point dog and won by eight. I lost a bet I'm not going to describe. But I learned something: the board knows things the projections don't. So here's how I'm doing it today. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense. Thursday points are already banked and don't count toward the environment numbers.

Three things move this whole slate. Lamar Jackson is out, so Tyler Huntley starts for Baltimore on Sunday night and the Ravens are implied for 20. Philadelphia plays in London without Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith or Marquise Brown, implied for 17. And Detroit at Arizona has a 54.5 total, with the Lions implied for 30, the best offense on the board. If your guys are in that game, you're eating. If they're in Houston at Tennessee, a 37.5 total, God help you.

sections.note: Bijan Your Face. Three starters in offenses implied for 25-plus, and Stroke already ate its Thursday dud.
p: The 4-0 machine against the 3-1 team that scores the second-most points in the league. Everybody wanted this one, and Thursday night already tilted it. CeeDee Lamb was projected for 20.71 and gave Stroke The Post 2.9 points: two catches, nine yards, and a bruised quad in the third quarter. Javonte Williams saved it with a touchdown and 14.2. Stroke leads 17.1 to 14.64 on Dak Prescott, and that lead is a mirage.

Look where Bijan's points live. Amon-Ra St. Brown is in Arizona with Detroit implied for 30, the top number on the slate. Michael Wilson is on the other side of that game, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is inactive while Arizona works on a trade, so Wilson eats the targets. Then Monday night Josh Allen and Davante Adams play each other in a 54.5-point game, Rams implied for 28.75 and Bills for 25.75. Bijan has both sides of the biggest Monday shootout of the year.

Stroke's best spots are in that same Monday game: Matthew Stafford and James Cook. The rest is mud. Michael Penix and Drake London get Baltimore on Sunday night at 23.5. Chris Olave and Juwan Johnson play in New Orleans, implied for 19.5. Jonathan Taylor is in Pittsburgh at 20.75. D'Andre Swift is the sneaky one, with Kyle Monangai out and Chicago implied for 23.75, but Tyson Bagent is the quarterback.

The only thing scaring me is Ashton Jeanty. Questionable with the ankle, missed Friday practice. If he's out, that's 12.74 projected points gone, and Bijan still wins by double digits. I'm laying the 25.5.

sections.note: Send Nudes. #StopAsianHate's 28-point Thursday lead is real money, but it has zero starters in an offense implied for 25.
p: George Pickens dropped 28.0 on Thursday night: nine catches, 130 yards and a touchdown. #StopAsianHate leads 28 to nothing, and it's still a 22.6-point underdog. That's how ugly the rest of this board is for them.

Start with Jalen Hurts. He's in London at 8:30 in the morning our time, and Philadelphia is implied for 17 because Barkley, Smith and Brown are all out. Deshaun Watson gets the Jets in a 39.5 total. Zay Flowers is questionable and now catches passes from Tyler Huntley. Jaxon Smith-Njigba against San Francisco is the only starter I trust, Seattle at 24.25. Lamar Jackson is sitting on this bench, out, which is the whole problem in one sentence.

Send Nudes has Jahmyr Gibbs in the 30-point Detroit spot, and Puka Nacua plus Kyren Williams in the Rams' 28.75 on Monday night. Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase stack in Miami with Cincinnati implied for 24.5. Chase is questionable with the concussion, but he was a full participant Friday and everyone expects him to play.
Two warnings. Derrick Henry runs behind Huntley now, Baltimore at 20. And if Chase doesn't clear, this gets closer than I like. I'm still on the champ.

sections.note: UPSET. Very Naughty Boys leads 7 to 0 and has the better board at almost every slot. Jackie's two running backs share one backfield in a 37.5-point game.
p: The projection says Jackie aCHANe by 14.6. I say the 0-4 team wins its first game today, and I've got the board to prove it. Very Naughty Boys' starters average a 22.4 implied team total. Jackie's average 20.8. Naughty Boys already leads 7 to 0 on Chris Godwin's Thursday.

Look at Jackie's running backs. David Montgomery and Woody Marks both play for Houston, in Tennessee, in the lowest total on the board: 37.5. That's one backfield split two ways in a game Vegas thinks will be a punt fest. Wan'Dale Robinson plays for the Titans, implied for 15.25, the worst offense on the slate. Will Shipley gets the Barkley carries, which is nice, for a Philly team implied for 17. Isaiah Williams is in the 39.5 Jets game. Jackie has zero starters in a 25-point offense.

Now Naughty Boys. Stefon Diggs is out in Washington, and Jayden Daniels is back, so Antonio Williams and Jacory Croskey-Merritt get more of a 22.75-point offense. Quentin Johnston is out for the Chargers, so Tre' Harris moves up the target tree. Dalton Kincaid plays Monday night in the 54.5-point Bills-Rams game. Sam Darnold gets San Francisco at home with Seattle favored.

Both managers are leaving points on the bench, too. Jackie is starting Daniel Jones at 13.17 with Malik Willis at 15.66 on the bench, and Isaiah Williams at 7.73 over Terry McLaurin. Naughty Boys has Tyler Huntley at 12.17 sitting behind Jordan Addison. Whoever wakes up first gets about four free points. I'm betting my watch the 0-4 team gets off the mat.

sections.note: Ben Football Team by a hair. Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta stack in the 30-point Detroit offense.
p: This is a coin flip with a commissioner on one side, which means I want my money far away from it. The projection says Ben Football Team by 1.8. The board agrees, barely.

Ben's edge is one game. Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta stack in Arizona with Detroit implied for 30, and that's the only 25-plus spot on either roster except Sheev's Khalil Shakir. Emanuel Wilson starts for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet still out. Bhayshul Tuten gets the London game, Jacksonville implied for 24.5. Ollie Gordon leads Miami's backfield with Jaylen Wright questionable. Jameis Winston is the problem: Giants implied for 19.25 in Washington.

Sheev gets Jayden Daniels back, no injury tag, at home against the Giants. Brock Purdy goes to Seattle with San Francisco at 21.25. TreVeyon Henderson and Parker Washington both sit at 24.5. Shakir arrived Saturday night for a third-round pick, and he plays Monday in the Bills' 25.75 spot with DJ Moore questionable. Quinshon Judkins and Harold Fannin are stuck in the Browns' 18.75.
Ben by a nose. If Daniels runs for two touchdowns, I never said this.

sections.note: brimley. Bucky Irving already scored 31.5, and Panic is starting a player Arizona ruled inactive.
p: Bucky Irving went for 165 rushing yards and two touchdowns on Thursday night, 31.5 points, and brimley leads Panic Trade Project 31.5 to 17.2. The projection says brimley by 73.5. I've never laid that many points in my life, and I'd lay them today.

Panic's lineup is a crime scene. Marvin Harrison Jr. is in a starting spot, and Arizona has ruled him inactive while it finalizes a trade. That's a zero unless somebody fixes it before 3:25. Carnell Tate plays for Tennessee, implied for 15.25, the worst number on the board. Jaylen Wright is questionable, and Miami is implied for 18. Rome Odunze catches passes from Tyson Bagent. Panic has zero starters in a 25-point offense.

brimley has questions, but they're good questions. Justin Jefferson is questionable but says he's playing. DJ Moore is questionable for Monday night, and his shoulder is the one thing worth watching. Trey McBride gets the Detroit shootout with Harrison gone. Trevor Lawrence plays in London with Jacksonville implied for 24.5. That's the lock.

sections.note: God Bless Vodka. ClutchJuice projects for 75 points total. That's not a team, that's a cry for help.
p: Two 1-3 teams. ClutchJuice projects for 75.0, the lowest in the league this week by more than 16 points. Cade Otton gave it 5.5 Thursday, and that might be the highlight.

There is one ClutchJuice angle. Breece Hall is out again for the Jets, so Braelon Allen gets the backfield, projected for 15.36. Drake Maye gets the Raiders at home with New England implied for 24.5. After that it's Kendre Miller and Demond Claiborne in the same Vikings-Saints game, and Rashod Bateman catching passes from Huntley.

Vodka's problem is the Chargers. Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton play without tackle Joe Alt, Rashawn Slater is on IR, and Los Angeles is implied for 19 against Denver. Cam Ward is in Tennessee at 15.25. But Jameson Williams is in the 30-point Detroit offense, Chase Brown gets Miami, and Nico Collins plays a Titans team Houston is favored to beat by seven. Vodka by 55. I'm not proud. I'm paid.

stories.headline: Baltimore Loses Its Quarterback, and Philadelphia Loses Almost Everyone
paragraphs: Good morning. Final injury reports came out Friday, and two teams' reports matter more than any single star. Lamar Jackson is out with an ankle injury, so Tyler Huntley starts Sunday night in Atlanta. Jackson sits on #StopAsianHate's bench, which matters less than the people around him: Derrick Henry (Send Nudes), Zay Flowers (#StopAsianHate) and Rashod Bateman (ClutchJuice) all lose their quarterback. Huntley himself sits on Very Naughty Boys' bench, projected for 12.17.

Philadelphia goes to London without Saquon Barkley (hamstring), DeVonta Smith and Marquise Brown. Vegas has the Eagles implied for 17. Will Shipley (Jackie aCHANe) inherits the backfield. Makai Lemon (Panic Trade Project), Dontayvion Wicks (Ben Football Team) and Darius Cooper (ClutchJuice) should see more targets, from a quarterback with fewer good options. That game kicks at 8:30 a.m. Central, and inactives arrive around 7:00 a.m. Set your lineups before you go back to sleep.

Now the questionable list. Ja'Marr Chase (Send Nudes) is in the concussion protocol. He went from no practice to limited to full by Friday, and the expectation is that he plays, but he has to clear an independent neurologist first, and I found no report that he has. Ashton Jeanty (Bijan Your Face) is the one I worry about: an ankle injury and no practice Friday. Justin Jefferson (brimley) and Jordan Addison (Very Naughty Boys) both practiced Friday. Jefferson says he's playing.

Two non-medical notes. Marvin Harrison Jr. is listed as out, but he isn't hurt. Arizona is finalizing a trade, and he'll be inactive against Detroit. Panic Trade Project has him in a starting spot, which is a lineup problem, not an injury. And CeeDee Lamb bruised his quadriceps on Thursday night. He returned but played sparingly, finishing with two catches for nine yards. Reports call it minor. Stroke The Post should watch his practice reports this week.

Monday night is the hard one. DJ Moore (brimley) has a shoulder injury and missed practice Thursday and Friday before showing up Saturday. I could not confirm Buffalo's final Saturday designation. A questionable tag tells you the risk, not whether he plays. Inactives come about 90 minutes before every kickoff, and that's the only list that counts.

thursday.label: Thursday Edition

lead.headline: Sheev Blows $25 on a Third-String Receiver
lead.deck: The commissioner outbid the field by $21 for Dohnte Meyers. Jackie aCHANe won the week's real auction for Will Shipley, then shipped Deebo Samuel and Aaron Rodgers to the defending champs.

stories.headline: Sheev Paid $25. The Next Bid Was $4.
paragraphs: Wednesday's waiver run had one real auction and one bid people will be bringing up for a while. Start with the bid. Sheev paid $25 for Dohnte Meyers, a 26-year-old rookie receiver listed third on Cincinnati's depth chart, and cut Xavier Hutchinson to make room. The next-highest bid was Send Nudes at $4. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 put in $0. The commissioner left $21 on the table and has now spent $70 of his $100 budget, the most in the league.

The real auction was Will Shipley, and four teams showed up. Jackie aCHANe won at $23 over Stroke The Post ($17), brimley ($15) and Bijan ($1). Sleeper lists Shipley first on Philadelphia's running back depth chart, and he goes straight into Jackie's lineup this week, projected for 11.09 against Jacksonville. That is what FAAB is for: a starting back, bought when the job opened, at a price the rest of the league confirmed. Add last week's $17 for Atlanta rookie receiver Zachariah Branch and Jackie has put $40 into a 22-year-old and a 24-year-old in a week, and $53 on the season. For a rebuild, that's coherent.

Best value of the run: Stroke The Post's $4 for Las Vegas tight end Michael Mayer, one dollar over Jackie and two over Bijan. Tight end is Stroke's weakest projected spot this week at 10.3, and Carson Wentz was the cut. Further down the bill, Send Nudes paid $1 for Detroit back Sione Vaki and cut Darren Waller, Sheev spent $5 on Washington rookie quarterback Athan Kaliakmanis and released Marcus Mariota, and on Sunday God Bless Vodka paid $4 for Austin Ekeler. ClutchJuice claimed Joe Mixon for $0. Sleeper currently lists Mixon without an NFL team, so file that one under lottery ticket.
The cuts tell a story too. Bijan dropped Jauan Jennings five days after paying $1 for him, brimley let Skyy Moore go, Stroke released George Holani and Ben Football Team cut Tyjae Spears.

What I'm watching: Jackie aCHANe has made three trades since Sunday. The latest sends Deebo Samuel, acquired from Sheev on Oct. 4, and Aaron Rodgers to Send Nudes for Malik Willis. The champs have Baker Mayfield on IR and both Ja'Marr Chase and Mike Evans listed as questionable, so they bought a quarterback and a receiver for this season. Mona Lott has the grades below.

And who still has ammunition: ClutchJuice has spent $1, God Bless Vodka $4 and brimley $6. Those three hold $289 of the league's remaining $829 in FAAB. When the next starting job opens, they can outbid everyone without blinking.

stories.headline: Follow the Quarterbacks
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood handles those on Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 5: where the projected points are, where Vegas expects points, and which edges are real. Kansas City and Carolina are on bye, and no league starter plays for either.

The game of the week is first against second. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is the league's only unbeaten team at 4-0 and scores 203.0 a game; Stroke The Post is 3-1 at 182.9, second-best. Bijan projects 181.6 to 166.1, and the gap is mostly quarterback: Josh Allen and Dak Prescott project 41.8 combined, Michael Penix and Matthew Stafford 33.2. Stroke's receivers out-project Bijan's by 3.5. That's Stroke's only positional edge.

Watch tonight. Dallas hosts Tampa Bay on Thursday Night Football, with the Cowboys favored by 7.5 to 9.5 depending on the book and a 47.5 total. Stroke has CeeDee Lamb and Javonte Williams in that game, 38.48 projected points. Bijan has Prescott at 19.75. Stroke can bank a real lead before Sunday's first kickoff.

The two shootouts on the board are Detroit-Arizona and Buffalo-Los Angeles, both with totals between 53.5 and 54.5. Bijan has four starters in those games: Allen, Davante Adams, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Michael Wilson. Send Nudes has three: Jahmyr Gibbs, Puka Nacua and Kyren Williams. At the other end, Houston-Tennessee carries a total of 37.5 to 39.5, the lowest of the week, with Tennessee implied for about 15 to 16 points. Jackie aCHANe has three starters in that game and God Bless Vodka has two.

The closest projected game is Sheev against Ben Football Team, 125.8 to 120.2. It's also the strangest. Sheev scores 157.7 a game, fourth-best in the league, and is 1-3 after facing the second-toughest schedule. Ben scores 121.7, seventh-best, and is 3-1 after facing the third-easiest. Ben's Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta account for 34.49 of its projection, and Detroit is implied for 29 to 30 points, the most of any team this week.

One last number. Two teams just traded for a quarterback and left him on the bench. Send Nudes starts Kirk Cousins (14.74) with Aaron Rodgers (16.77) behind him. Jackie aCHANe starts Daniel Jones (13.35) with Malik Willis (15.39) behind him. Lineups can change before Sunday. Jackie's season lineup efficiency is 76%, the lowest in the league, so this is worth watching.

intel.note: First vs. second. Bijan's quarterbacks out-project Stroke's by 8.6, and that is most of the 15.5-point gap. Stroke has 38.5 projected points in tonight's Dallas-Tampa Bay game (Lamb, Javonte Williams) to Bijan's 19.75 (Prescott), so Thursday night sets the tone.

The closest projection of the week: 5.6 points. Sheev averages 157.7 and is 1-3; Ben averages 121.7 and is 3-1. Ben's Goff and LaPorta play in Detroit-Arizona, the week's biggest total, with Detroit implied for 29 to 30, the most of any team.

Jackie's quarterbacks out-project Very Naughty Boys' by 13.6. Three Jackie starters (Montgomery, Woody Marks, Wan'Dale Robinson) play in Houston-Tennessee, the lowest total on the board. New pickup Will Shipley starts; new quarterback Malik Willis (15.39) sits behind Daniel Jones (13.35).

The biggest positional edge of the week: Send Nudes' running backs out-project #StopAsianHate's by 23.5. Ja'Marr Chase and Mike Evans are both questionable, which is where newly acquired Deebo Samuel comes in. Aaron Rodgers (16.77) is on the bench behind Kirk Cousins (14.74).

Nico Collins and Chase Brown both start for Vodka. Collins draws Tennessee in the week's lowest total; Brown's Bengals are favored by 6.5 to 7.5 in Miami. ClutchJuice has the receivers' gap to close, 50.0 to 29.2, with two receivers who have no projection.

The widest projected margin of the week: 57.2. brimley has faced 197.1 points a game, the most in the league by 40.1, so its 1-3 record is mostly schedule. Panic's tight end projects 3.2; brimley's Trey McBride projects 18.0.

thursday.intelNote: Proj = sum of Sleeper's Week 5 projections for each starting lineup as set Thursday morning. Starters without a Sleeper projection count as 7 points. Vegas lines cited in the column are consensus numbers from VegasInsider, Covers and Yahoo Sports as of Oct. 7–8.

lead.headline: 63 Points on the Bench: Stroke Blows It as the Champ Cashes In
lead.deck: Send Nudes hands Stroke The Post its first loss, 191.52 to 155.50, while Stroke's best lineup sat idle. Bijan Your Face is the last unbeaten team, the commissioner finally wins, and Jackie aCHANe sells Nico Collins to the team he just beat.

stories.headline: One Unbeaten, One Bad Bench and One Very Awkward Trade
intro: Week 4 in one sentence: the unbeaten list shrank to one, the commissioner finally won, and two teams that played each other on Sunday made a trade on Monday.

Bijan Your Face is alone at 4-0. Four teams sit at 3-1: Stroke The Post, Send Nudes, Ben Football Team and Jackie aCHANe. Six teams make the playoffs, and the sixth spot belongs to #StopAsianHate at 2-2, ahead of Panic Trade Project on points scored, 603.36 to 367.26. Here is every game.

p: The champ came in as a 1.8-point favorite on Sunday's lineup projections and won by 36.02. Send Nudes posted 191.52, the high score of the week, and handed Stroke The Post its first loss.

Kyren Williams did the heavy lifting with 36.7 points against a 13.61 projection, and Puka Nacua added 27.7, so the Rams pair alone produced 64.4. Joe Burrow scored 25.72 and Kirk Cousins added 23.6 in the superflex. That cushion mattered, because Ja'Marr Chase managed 5.7 and is now listed out with a concussion.

Here is the detail that will sting in Stroke's group chat. CeeDee Lamb scored 41.3, the second-best individual score in the league this week, and Stroke still lost because of who sat. Javonte Williams scored 31.3 on the bench, Keon Coleman 23.6 and Alvin Kamara 22.8, while D'Andre Swift (7.4), Garrett Wilson (5.7) and Travis Kelce (3.5) started. Stroke's best possible lineup was 218.72, which would have been the top score of the week by 27.2 points. It left 63.22 points on the bench, the most in the league.
sections.note: Send Nudes is 3-1 with three straight wins. Stroke The Post falls into a four-way tie at 3-1 and gets the unbeaten team next.

p: Bijan Your Face won 184.26 to 147.4 and is the last unbeaten team in the league. It got there the way it usually does: everybody contributed. Bijan Robinson scored 27.7, Tee Higgins 26.7, Brock Bowers 20.6 and Ashton Jeanty 18.6. Nine of ten starters reached double figures. Davante Adams, at 7.2, was the only exception.

#StopAsianHate had its moments. Kenneth Walker, acquired from Sheev on Oct. 1, scored 30.9, and Zay Flowers played through a questionable tag for 25.8. But Rashee Rice started and scored zero, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba managed 12.6 against a 22.6 projection. RJ Harvey (19.3) and Rhamondre Stevenson (18.4) sat on the bench, though even the best possible lineup, 177.9, would have come up short.
sections.note: Bijan Your Face leads the league with 811.9 points, 80.3 more than anyone else. #StopAsianHate drops to 2-2.

p: Ben Football Team came in as a 24.3-point underdog on Sunday's lineup projections and won by 72.62, 183.88 to 111.26. After three trades in one week, the new pieces delivered: Sam LaPorta scored 22.4, Patrick Mahomes 17.0 and Bhayshul Tuten 11.1.

The bigger contributions came from players who were already there. Emanuel Wilson scored 27.0 on a 9.15 projection, Chuba Hubbard 25.9 and T.J. Hockenson 24.9. Jared Goff added 20.48 in the superflex. Ben's 183.88 beat its previous season high by 65.68 points.

brimley was the opposite. Saquon Barkley scored 2.0 and is now listed out with a hamstring injury. DJ Moore had 2.7 and Bucky Irving 6.1, which wasted strong games from Romeo Doubs (23.8) and Malik Nabers (23.2). Brian Robinson scored 25.7 on the bench. brimley has now faced 788.38 points, the most in the league by 160.28. That is a brutal schedule, but this loss was not about the schedule.
sections.note: Ben Football Team is 3-1. brimley has lost three straight and is 1-3.

p: The commissioner finally has a win. Sheev scored 180.4, the fourth-best score of the week, and beat Panic Trade Project by 90.14, the largest margin of Week 4.

Tetairoa McMillan was the story with 45.2 points, the best individual score in the league this week. Kyle Monangai turned an 8.15 projection into 28.0, and Quinshon Judkins, the back Sheev bought from #StopAsianHate, added 21.6. C.J. Stroud (23.08) and Brock Purdy (19.62) were steady. The only real miss was Parker Washington at 2.0.

Panic Trade Project had a rough day at the skill spots. Jaylen Wright scored 0.7, Eli Raridon 2.2 and Emeka Egbuka 3.3. Carnell Tate (21.5) and Rome Odunze (15.4) were the only starters above 15. Panic's best possible lineup was 95.46, so this wasn't a lineup mistake. The roster just didn't have it.
sections.note: Sheev is 1-3 but has scored 630.84 points, fourth in the league. Panic Trade Project falls to 2-2.

p: Jackie aCHANe won 142.34 to 103.42, and the box score now reads like a trade negotiation. Nico Collins scored 30.8 and Chase Brown 19.1 for Jackie. On Monday, God Bless Vodka traded for both of them.

Bryce Young added 21.46 and Tucker Kraft 16.5. Jackie still left 36.48 points on its bench. Aaron Rodgers scored 23.96 there while Kyler Murray started in the superflex and scored 11.48, and Deebo Samuel, acquired from Sheev on Sunday, scored 18.0 without leaving the bench. Jackie's lineup efficiency for the season is 76%, the lowest in the league.

Vodka's problems were at the top. Geno Smith started in the superflex and scored 8.76 while Cam Ward scored 16.58 on the bench. Jeremiyah Love scored 6.5 against a 15.9 projection and is now listed questionable with an ankle injury. Josh Downs had 4.6 and Jake Ferguson 4.1, with Mark Andrews scoring 13.7 on the bench.
sections.note: Jackie aCHANe is 3-1. God Bless Vodka is 1-3 and has lost three straight.

p: The lowest-scoring game of the week was also the closest. ClutchJuice won 88.86 to 85.62 as a 21.1-point underdog on Sunday's projections.
Drake Maye made the difference in his first start for ClutchJuice with 27.16 points, more than 30% of the team's total. Malachi Fields added 13.2 on a 5.29 projection.

Very Naughty Boys is the only winless team left. Dalton Kincaid scored 1.7 against a 12.19 projection, Jacory Croskey-Merritt 7.0 and Jordan Addison 9.1. The bench couldn't save it either: the best possible lineup was 87.52, still 1.34 short.
sections.note: ClutchJuice gets its first win and is 1-3. Very Naughty Boys is 0-4.

stories.headline: Stroke The Post Lost a Game It Won
paragraphs: Stroke The Post lost a game it won. I mean that literally. The best lineup on Stroke's roster was 218.72, which beats every score in the league this week. Instead Stroke started Travis Kelce for 3.5 and watched Javonte Williams drop 31.3 on the bench. That's 63.22 points on the pine. That's not a bench, that's a second franchise. And next up is the 4-0 Bijan Your Face. Set your lineup, my guy.

Ben Football Team got roasted all week for burning it down. Three trades, a 2028 first out the door, Mahomes in, Maye out. Result: 183.88, Ben's best score of the season by 65.68 points, and a win as a 24.3-point underdog. Am I saying the trades were smart? No. Mona has receipts on that. But I'm saying 3-1 is 3-1. Ben's luck rating is +1.36, second-highest in the league, so enjoy it while the dice are warm.

My favorite team in the league is Jackie aCHANe, purely as performance art. 3-1 with the eighth-most points. The easiest schedule in the league at 84.0 points against per game. The luckiest record in the league at +1.73. And on Monday, the day after Nico Collins dropped 30.8 on God Bless Vodka, Jackie sold Collins and Chase Brown to God Bless Vodka. That's beating a guy at poker and then selling him your chips back at a markup. Jackie now holds four first-round picks across 2027 and 2028.

The commissioner won. Alert the media, which is us. Tetairoa McMillan put up 45.2, the best single score of the week, and Sheev beat Panic by 90.14. Sheev's luck rating is still -1.64, the worst in the league. Fourth in points, 1-3 in the standings. That's a playoff roster wearing a 1-3 costume.

Credit where it's due, and it physically hurts me: Jeff Longwood went 5-1 on Sunday. He hit his upset of the week with Ben over brimley. His only miss was the toilet bowl, where he took Very Naughty Boys and ClutchJuice won by 3.24. Somebody check that he still has a watch.

Week 5 game to circle: Bijan Your Face (4-0, 203.0 a game) against Stroke The Post (3-1, 182.9 a game). The two highest-scoring teams in the league. If Stroke starts its best players, this is the game of the year so far. If it doesn't, start planning the Bijan parade.

projNote: Projections are Sleeper's Week 5 numbers summed across each starting lineup. On Sunday, Thursday night starters count their actual points, and Marvin Harrison Jr. counts zero because Arizona has ruled him inactive.

breakdown.headline: Paying Thirds for Depth, With No Picks of Its Own Left
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power with a young core, but every pick it holds through round three in 2027 and 2028 came from somebody else.
breakdown.move: Stop spending picks on depth receivers. Sell C.J. Stroud, the third quarterback, for a first-round pick while Jayden Daniels and Brock Purdy start.
p: Sheev is 1-3 and fifth in dynasty value at 65,441, down one spot from last week. The record still undersells the team. Sheev scores 157.7 a game, fourth in the league, and has faced 157.0 a game, the second-toughest schedule. Its luck factor of -1.64 is the worst in the league.

The roster is the youngest of the top six. Value-weighted age is 24.5, third-youngest in the league, and 59% of the value sits in players 25 or younger. Nobody on the roster is 27. Tetairoa McMillan, Luther Burden, Jordyn Tyson, Quinshon Judkins and Harold Fannin are all 24 or younger.

The commissioner made two trades this week, and both went the same direction. On Oct. 9, Sheev sent Jonathon Brooks and its 2028 third to brimley for Roman Wilson. On Saturday night it sent its 2027 third to Jackie aCHANe for Khalil Shakir and a 2027 sixth. Both receivers start today. Both cost picks.

That's the concern. Sheev's own 2027 first is with Very Naughty Boys, its 2027 second with Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third and 2028 second with Jackie aCHANe, its 2028 first with ClutchJuice and its 2028 third with brimley. What Sheev holds is borrowed: Ben Football Team's 2027 first, #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second, and Bijan Your Face's 2028 third. Pick value is 7,150, seventh in the league.
The quarterback room is still the leverage. Daniels is back, Purdy is healthy, and C.J. Stroud (3,439) sits on the bench in a league where starting quarterbacks are currency.

breakdown.headline: A Rebuild That Bought 27-Year-Olds
breakdown.verdict: Stuck between windows. Jeremiyah Love is the future. Nico Collins and Chase Brown are the present. There are no firsts.
breakdown.move: Pick a direction. At 1-3 with no first-round picks, sell George Kittle and Geno Smith now and build around Love, Omarion Hampton and Cam Ward.
p: God Bless Vodka is 1-3, ninth in scoring at 112.0 a game, and ninth in dynasty value at 53,020. The all-play mark of 1.55 says the record is about fair.
The best asset is Jeremiyah Love (5,935) at 21.3, the 19th most valuable player in the league. Hampton (23.5) and Ward (24.3) give the roster a young second layer. Jadarian Price remains on IR.

The Oct. 5 trade is the puzzle. Vodka sent Matthew Golden, its own 2028 first and fourth, and Bijan Your Face's 2027 first and third to Jackie aCHANe for Nico Collins (27.5), Chase Brown (26.5) and Jackie's 2028 second. That's a win-now trade from a team our model calls a rebuild. The result: value-weighted age rose to 26.0, and only 43% of value is in players 25 or younger.

The pick cupboard is nearly empty. Bijan Your Face owns Vodka's 2027 first and second, and Jackie aCHANe owns its 2028 first. What's left is its own 2027 third, two 2028 seconds (its own and Jackie's) and its own 2028 third, 4,851 in all.
Kittle is 33.0 and still starting. A tight end that age is a depreciating asset with injury risk every week. Sell him while he still scores.

breakdown.headline: The Oldest Roster in the League, Built to Repeat
breakdown.verdict: Win-now champion. Three top-10 assets and the league's oldest value profile.
breakdown.move: Ride it this year. Next offseason, use the 2028 first to buy a young quarterback before Burrow's 30s and the Rodgers rental run out.
p: Here's what I'm hearing around the league: nobody wants to see the champ in December. Send Nudes is 3-1, scores 173.0 a game (third), and has an all-play mark of 3.36, tied with Stroke The Post for second behind Bijan Your Face. Dynasty value is 71,674, second.

The stars are elite. Jahmyr Gibbs (10,252) is the third-most valuable asset in the league. Ja'Marr Chase (8,601) is fifth, and Puka Nacua (7,888) is seventh. Joe Burrow (6,225) and Kyren Williams (4,303) round out the core.

Then there's the age. Value-weighted age is 28.0, the oldest in the league, and 38% of the value is in players 29 or older. The Oct. 7 trade made it older: Aaron Rodgers (42.8) and Deebo Samuel (30.7) arrived for Malik Willis. With Baker Mayfield on IR, Rodgers starts today.
The picks are thin. Very Naughty Boys owns Send Nudes' 2027 first and second. What's left is its own 2027 third and its own 2028 first, second and third, 5,722 in all, eighth in the league.
That's the right shape for a champion. It's the wrong shape for 2028, and the champ knows it.

breakdown.headline: Full Teardown, Full Pick Board
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild, and the most committed one in the league. More draft capital than anyone.
breakdown.move: Keep doing exactly this. Flip any veteran that scores points in October for more 2028 picks.
p: ClutchJuice is 0-3 and ranks 11th in dynasty value. That's not a problem. That's the plan.

ClutchJuice holds 25,612 points of draft capital, the most in the league. Three 2027 firsts: its own, brimley's and #StopAsianHate's. Three 2027 seconds: its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's. Three 2027 thirds. Two 2028 firsts, its own and Sheev's. Only Very Naughty Boys is close.

The roster is the other half of the plan, and it's thin by design. Drake Maye, acquired for Patrick Mahomes, is the only player valued above 1,500 in dynasty. The rest is young depth: Braelon Allen, Caleb Douglas, Pat Bryant, Malachi Fields, Germie Bernard and a taxi squad of recent draft picks. Value-weighted age is 24.2, and 86% of the value sits in players 25 or younger, the highest share in the league.

Credit where it's due: ClutchJuice sets the most efficient lineups in the league, capturing 94% of its available points. The manager isn't tanking with bad decisions. There just isn't much talent to start yet.

The model projects 2.5 wins, the fewest in the league. That makes ClutchJuice's own 2027 first a likely top-two pick. brimley's first is the wild card: it projects mid-round, but if brimley's schedule keeps beating it up, that pick climbs too.

breakdown.headline: The Toughest Schedule in the League, and a Bet on an Injured Back
breakdown.verdict: A real contender stuck at 1-3 by its schedule. The roster is good. The calendar on its older pieces is short.
breakdown.move: If today goes as projected, hold and buy. If brimley falls to 1-4, sell Saquon Barkley and DJ Moore before their value drops further.
p: brimley has allowed 197.1 points a game, the most in the league by 40. That's how a team that scores 138.0 a game, sixth-best, starts 1-3. The all-play record of 2.18 says it should be about 2-2, and the luck factor of -1.18 is the second-worst in the league.

Dynasty value is 62,556, sixth. The core is strong: Trey McBride (6,824), Justin Jefferson (6,216), Malik Nabers (5,426, age 23.2) and Trevor Lawrence (5,260). Bucky Irving already gave the team 31.5 points on Thursday.

The age profile is the issue. Value-weighted age is 26.9, and only 24% of value sits in players 25 or younger. Barkley (29.6), Moore (29.4), Stefon Diggs (32.8) and Jacoby Brissett (33.8) are all on the roster, and Barkley and Diggs are both out today.

On Oct. 9, brimley sent Roman Wilson to Sheev for Jonathon Brooks and Sheev's 2028 third. It won the trade on market value, but Brooks is on IR with an abdominal injury, and a 1-3 team needs points now.

The pick board is respectable but missing its best piece. ClutchJuice owns brimley's 2027 first. brimley still has its own 2027 second and third, Stroke The Post's 2027 third, and its own 2028 first and second, plus Sheev's 2028 third.

breakdown.headline: The Name Is Panic. The Plan Is Patience.
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild, and a well-stocked one. Youngest roster in the league and the third-most draft capital. The 2-1 record is borrowed.
breakdown.move: Don't be fooled by 2-1. Sell anything older than 26 for 2027 picks and keep stacking.
p: Panic Trade Project is 2-1. Panic Trade Project is not a 2-1 team. The all-play mark is 0.73, meaning a typical schedule produces fewer than one win. The luck factor is +1.27, the most in the league, helped by just 91 points allowed per game, the second-easiest schedule.
But I don't think bhegg97 cares about this season, and he shouldn't. This is the youngest roster in the league by value-weighted age, 23.9, with 84% of its value in players 25 or younger.

The quarterback plan is a three-way bet: Bo Nix (26.6), Jaxson Dart (23.4), the most valuable player on the roster, and rookie Ty Simpson on the taxi squad. The receiver room is all youth: Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate (21.7), Makai Lemon, Jalen Coker, Marvin Harrison Jr. and Rome Odunze. Running back is the hole. Keaton Mitchell and Jaylen Wright are FAAB adds, and Kaleb Johnson came over in the ClutchJuice trade.

The draft capital is 15,321, third-most in the league: its own 2027 first, Stroke The Post's 2027 first, 2027 seconds from Sheev and Ben Football Team, its own 2028 first, and 2028 seconds from Stroke and itself.

Its own 2027 first slots mid-round right now because of the 2-1 record. The model projects only 5.0 wins, the third-fewest in the league, so that pick should climb. The trades have a plan, even if the team name doesn't.

breakdown.headline: A Young Star and Two Quarterbacks on the Clock
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power, but thin on picks after the Judkins and Walker trades.
breakdown.move: Protect the quarterback depth. Lamar Jackson's back and Jalen Hurts' age are the two risks that matter most.
p: #StopAsianHate ranks third in dynasty value at 67,531 and has the youngest value-weighted age of the top three teams at 26.5. From a durability standpoint, this roster is in good shape. With two caveats.

The franchise piece is Jaxon Smith-Njigba. At 24.6, he's the fourth-most valuable asset in dynasty and the kind of receiver who gets better for three more seasons. Zay Flowers (26.0), George Pickens (25.6), Ladd McConkey (24.9) and Rashee Rice (26.4) give him the deepest supporting cast of receivers in the league.

Now the caveats. Lamar Jackson is 29.7 and listed with a back issue this week, no game designation. Jalen Hurts is 28.1. Running quarterbacks age faster than pocket passers because they take hits. In superflex, losing either one would hurt more than losing any receiver.

Kenneth Walker, acquired in the Judkins trade, is 25.9 and has missed time in past seasons. He's the lead back now, with Cam Skattebo (24.6) behind him. Rookie tight end Kenyon Sadiq is on the taxi squad and questionable this week with a back injury.

The cost of building this roster was future picks. #StopAsianHate's 2027 first and third belong to ClutchJuice, and its 2028 first and second went to Sheev. Its own 2027 second is the only pick it holds in the first two rounds of either draft. The record is fair: 2-1 against an all-play of 2.09. The model projects 9.2 wins.

breakdown.headline: The Rare Team That Wins Now and Later
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power. Best roster today and the most draft capital of any contender.
breakdown.move: Sell Davante Adams, Dak Prescott and Tyreek Hill while they still return value. None of them will matter in 2028.
p: Bijan Your Face isn't just the best team in the league. It's the best-built one. Its dynasty score of 92,605 is more than 22,000 points clear of second-place Send Nudes.

Start with the core. Bijan Robinson (24.6), Brock Bowers (23.8) and Ashton Jeanty (22.8) are the third, seventh and 13th most valuable assets in all of dynasty, and none is older than 25. Josh Allen is No. 1 overall in superflex. Amon-Ra St. Brown is No. 8 and in his prime. Most teams in this league have one or two foundation pieces. This one has five.

The risk is the back half of the roster. A third of the team's value sits in players 29 or older: Allen and Christian McCaffrey (both 30.3), Dak Prescott (33.2), Davante Adams (33.8) and Tyreek Hill (32.6). Allen ages well because quarterbacks do. The rest are the kind of assets that lose half their value in a single offseason.

The record is earned. A 3-0 start with an all-play mark of 2.73 means Bijan would have beaten 91% of the league in an average week. Luck is a rounding error at +0.27. The model projects 11.8 wins, the best in the league.

And the cupboard is real. Bijan traded its own 2027 first to God Bless Vodka but holds Vodka's 2027 first and second in return, and Vodka's first currently projects early. Add two 2028 firsts (its own and Ben Football Team's) and Ben's 2028 third. That's 12,847 in draft capital, the most of any team in the top six.

breakdown.headline: Losing Is the Plan, and the Picks Prove It
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild with the most valuable set of 2027 firsts in the league.
breakdown.move: Keep the youth, keep the picks, and shop Send Nudes' late first for a young back if the price is right.
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-3 and the model projects just 3.0 wins. For most teams, that's a crisis. For this one, it's a strategy, because Very Naughty Boys owns its own 2027 first, and it currently projects early.

It also owns Sheev's 2027 first, which projects early too after the commissioner's 0-3 start, plus Send Nudes' first. Three 2027 firsts, two of them early, is the most valuable set of 2027 firsts in the league. Add three 2027 seconds (its own, Send Nudes' and Bijan Your Face's) and its own 2028 first. That's 21,023 in draft capital, second only to ClutchJuice.

The young core is promising. Fernando Mendoza (23.0) is on the taxi squad as the quarterback of the future. Colston Loveland (22.5) is a long-term tight end, and rookie KC Concepcion (22.0) is already starting. Value-weighted age is 24.7.

The veterans are where the injury risk lives. Chris Godwin plays for Tampa Bay, which lost Baker Mayfield this week. J.K. Dobbins is listed with a hip issue and no game designation, and running backs with his injury history are year-to-year propositions. Sam Darnold (29.3) is the starting quarterback: a bridge, not a plan.
The luck factor is -0.36, so the record is roughly deserved. That's fine. Every loss this season makes next spring's draft more interesting.

breakdown.headline: Built for Right Now, and Right Now Only
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power with a short window. Prime-age core, almost nothing in the draft cupboard.
breakdown.move: Use Caleb Williams as the trade chip. He's the roster's most valuable asset and its only young one, and he's the cleanest way to get a 2027 first back.
p: Stroke The Post is the purest win-now roster in the league, and I mean that as a compliment and a warning.

Look at the ages. CeeDee Lamb 27.5, Jonathan Taylor 27.7, Chris Olave 26.2, Drake London 25.2, James Cook 27.0, Garrett Wilson 26.2. Every major skill player is between 25 and 28, exactly where fantasy production peaks. Only 14% of the roster's value is in players 25 and under, the lowest share in the league.

The quarterback room is the oddity. Matthew Stafford is 38.6 and starting at superflex. Caleb Williams, at 24.8 the 11th most valuable asset in dynasty and the most valuable player on this roster, sits on the bench and is out this week with a hamstring injury.
The 3-0 record is real. The all-play mark is 2.73, tied with Bijan for best in the league, and Stroke has topped 178 points every week. The model projects 11.3 wins.

The cost shows up on the draft board. Stroke's 2027 first belongs to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 second to Ben Football Team, its 2027 third to brimley and its 2028 second to Panic. All that's left is its own 2028 first and third, worth 3,065 combined, second-fewest in the league. This roster has roughly a two-season window before the running backs age out, and very little to restock it with.

breakdown.headline: All In on a Hand the Numbers Don't Like
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild by the numbers, managed like a contender. Last in dynasty value with the fewest picks.
breakdown.move: Commit. If Ben is buying, buy one more young running back. Going halfway is the worst outcome.
p: Ben Football Team made three trades in Week 4 and walked out with Patrick Mahomes and Sam LaPorta. Ben is clearly playing to win now. The numbers say he's playing from last place.

Ben Football Team ranks 12th in dynasty value at 40,857. Thirty-one percent of the roster's value sits in players 29 or older, the third-highest share in the league. Mahomes is 31.0. Jared Goff, the other starting quarterback, is 31.9.

The draft cost of the buying spree is steep. Sheev owns Ben's 2027 first. Panic Trade Project owns Ben's 2027 second, and ClutchJuice its third. Bijan Your Face owns Ben's 2028 first and third. Ben has 2,870 in draft capital left, the least in the league: Stroke The Post's 2027 second and his own 2028 second.

The 2-1 record isn't what it looks like either. The all-play mark is 0.82, and the luck factor is +1.18, tied for second-luckiest. The new roster projects better than the old one, but the model still sees 6.1 wins.

There are young pieces here: Bhayshul Tuten (23.6), rookie Denzel Boston (22.8) and LaPorta (25.7). But this is a two-quarterback, 31-year-old core with no first-round picks for two years. If it doesn't make the playoffs this season, the recovery takes a long time.

breakdown.headline: 3-1, Luckiest in the League, and Selling Anyway
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild that finally behaves like one. The record is a schedule artifact, and the pick haul is real.
breakdown.move: Keep selling. David Montgomery (29.3), Jakobi Meyers (29.9) and Terry McLaurin (31.0) won't be worth more than they are now. And start Malik Willis.
p: Jackie aCHANe is 3-1 and 11th in dynasty value at 50,104, down one spot. Both facts make sense. Jackie has faced 84.0 points a game, the easiest schedule in the league, and its luck factor of +1.73 is the highest. The all-play mark is 1.27, ninth.
The lineup efficiency is 76%, the lowest in the league. This week Jackie is starting Daniel Jones (13.17 projected) over Malik Willis (15.66) and Isaiah Williams (7.73) over Terry McLaurin (11.86).

The front office has been busy. On Oct. 5 it sent Nico Collins and Chase Brown to God Bless Vodka for Matthew Golden, Vodka's 2028 first and fourth, and Bijan Your Face's 2027 first and third. On Oct. 7 it sent Aaron Rodgers and Deebo Samuel to Send Nudes for Willis. On Saturday night it sent Khalil Shakir to Sheev for Sheev's 2027 third.

The result is a real pick board: its own 2027 first and Bijan's, three 2027 thirds (its own is gone; it holds Sheev's, Panic Trade Project's and Bijan's), its own 2028 first and Vodka's, and Sheev's 2028 second. Pick value is 14,991, fourth in the league.

The player side is thinner than the record suggests. Bryce Young (4,245) sits on the bench, and De'Von Achane (4,191) is out for the season with a torn ACL. Tucker Kraft and Golden are the only young starters with real value.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 10 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: The Commissioner Goes Shopping
tradeGrades.intro: Two new trades since Thursday, and Sheev is in both. On Oct. 9 it sent Jonathon Brooks and its 2028 third to brimley for Roman Wilson. On Saturday night it sent its 2027 third to Jackie aCHANe for Khalil Shakir and a 2027 sixth. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Fit is whether the pieces solve a real roster problem. Timing is whether the move matches where the team actually is. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade.

sides.reason: Sheev paid its 2027 third (1,101) for a receiver worth 1,215, so the price was fair. Shakir starts Monday night in Buffalo's 25.75-point spot, with DJ Moore questionable. The deduction is the pattern: this is Sheev's second third-round pick spent on a depth receiver in three days, and it no longer holds any of its own first-, second- or third-round picks in 2027 or 2028.

Jackie took a small value loss, 1,101 for 1,215, to turn a 26-year-old receiver into a pick. That fits a team that ranks 11th in dynasty value. The timing is awkward: Jackie is 3-1 and starting Isaiah Williams, projected for 7.73, at receiver this week.

Sheev gave up 2,338 in value, Jonathon Brooks (1,340) plus its 2028 third (998), for a receiver worth 1,362. Wilson does fill a starting spot, and Michael Pittman's foot injury should push more targets his way in Pittsburgh. But a 1-3 team with the worst luck in the league doesn't need to overpay for a WR3. That's a 976-point loss for a marginal upgrade.

brimley won on value by 976 and added a 23-year-old back. The problem is timing. brimley is a 1-3 contender that needs points now, and Brooks is on IR with an abdominal injury. Good business, wrong week.

trades.title: Rodgers and Deebo to the champs

sides.reason: Send Nudes is 3-1, the defending champion, and has Baker Mayfield on IR, so a quarterback who starts on Sunday is worth more to it than the market price says. Rodgers projects 16.77 this week to Willis's 15.39, and Samuel, who scored 18.0 on Jackie's bench in Week 4, is insurance with Ja'Marr Chase and Mike Evans both questionable. It also won on value, 2,871 to 1,794. The deduction: neither player will matter in two years. For a contender, this is the right kind of rental.

Jackie lost 1,077 in market value here, and Samuel was sold three days after he arrived. But Jackie is a rebuild, and in superflex, turning a 42-year-old and a 30-year-old into a 27-year-old listed atop Miami's depth chart is the right direction. Across both Samuel deals, Jackie turned Zach Charbonnet, a back on the PUP list worth 1,812, into Willis and Sheev's 2028 second, 3,166 combined. That's good business, even if this leg of it wasn't.

This is selling at the top. Jackie aCHANe is 3-1 on the easiest schedule in the league and has the luckiest record by all-play, so this was the moment to cash out a 27-year-old receiver and a 26-year-old back. It now holds four first-round picks across 2027 and 2028, and Golden is 23. The minus: the lineup gets thinner for a team currently sitting in a playoff spot.

On value this is close to even, 9,792 to 9,430, so nobody got fleeced. The problem is timing. God Bless Vodka is 1-3 and ninth in points, and it now owns no first-round pick in 2027 or 2028; Bijan Your Face already holds its 2027 first and second. There is one logic here: with that 2027 first gone, losing only helps someone else. But spending the last first on two players 26 and older is a bet on this season from a team that hasn't shown it can win one.

Sheev paid a 2028 second to swap a 30-year-old receiver for a younger back who is on the PUP list with an ACL injury. Charbonnet fits the youth build, but he's worth about 1,000 less than what went out and can't help a 1-3 team that needs wins now. The commissioner gets no special treatment at this desk.

Jackie aCHANe added a usable receiver and a second-round pick for an injured back. Samuel scored 18.0 on Jackie's bench the same day. A 30-year-old doesn't fit a rebuild, but a day later Jackie sold Nico Collins, so Samuel fills that hole while the picks pile up. Update: three days later Jackie flipped Samuel and Aaron Rodgers to Send Nudes for Malik Willis (graded above).

tradeGrades.note: Values are current dynasty market values, not values at the time of the trade. Sixth-round picks carry no market value. Trade details come straight from Sleeper's transaction records.
